answer: Each identity stakes 230 POA to set a marble token on a willow branch above the shared mirror pool, its reflection keyed to the owner's first job receipt; at dawn two neighbors check whether the reflection shows a second marble, proving a second token was set from one stake; a forged marble's reflection mismatches, the 230 POA kept, owner barred five epochs; ten clones need ten marbles, ten branches, ten separate settings = 2,300 POA, no marble/branch/setting shared or reused.
